contextual_resolubility_validation.validation_summary: Three ambiguities detected in the requirement text. The controlled context provides some help but does not fully resolve all ambiguities.

ambiguity_resolubility.fragment: the glass break detector of a window
unsupported_interpretations: A device that detects broken glass is installed on the window.
The window itself has an integrated glass break sensor.
evidence_from_requirement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

evidence_from_context.definition: Sensor that detects vibration or sound patterns from broken glass.

missing_information: The context does not specify whether the 'glass break detector' is an integrated part of the window or a separate device.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text mentions both the 'glass break detector' and the 'window', but it does not clarify if they are one and the same.

unsupported_interpretations: The entire window has been damaged.
Only the glass part of the window has been damaged.
evidence_from_requirement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged
missing_information: The context does not specify whether 'pane' refers to the entire window or just the glass part.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text mentions 'the pane', but it does not clarify if it refers to the entire window or just the glass part.

unsupported_interpretations: An internal security team will be informed.
An external security company will be contacted.
evidence_from_requirement: within 2 seconds at the latest. The system shall inform the security service
missing_information: The context does not specify whether 'security service' refers to an internal or external entity.
ambiguity_resolubility.justification: The requirement text mentions 'the security service', but it does not clarify if it refers to an internal or external team.

overall_resolubility.explanation: At least one ambiguity is unresolved; the case must bypass Agent 3.
